Job Posting: 179187 - Position: S26 Security Administrator Co-op 179187B Co-op Work Term Posted: 2026 - Summer App Deadline Application Method: Posting Goes Live: Job Posting Status: 03/20/2026 09:00 AM Through Employer Website 03/13/2026 03:50 PM Approved ORGANIZATION INFORMATION Organization Country Foresters Financial Canada JOB POSTING INFORMATION Placement Term <b> Job Title <b> Position Type Job Location Country Duration Work Mode 2026 - Summer S26 Security Administrator Co-op 179187B Co-op Position Toronto, ON Canada 4 or 8 months To be confirmed Salary Currency CAD 0.0 per hour for 0 Major List $21.00 - $30.00 per hour Salary Salary Range $ Job Description Role Title Security Administrator Co-op Purpose of role The Information Security Administrator Co-op position is designed for students or recent graduates who are eager to gain hands-on experience in the field of information security. This role provides an excellent opportunity to work with seasoned professionals, enhance your security skills, and contribute to the protection of Foresters information assets. Job Description Key Responsibilities: As an Information Security Administrator Co-op, you will be responsible for a variety of tasks that ensure the security and integrity of the Foresters information systems. Your key responsibilities will include: Security Monitoring and Incident Response • Monitor the Foresters networks and systems for security breaches through established tools and methodologies. • Identify and respond to security incidents, investigate potential security threats, and escalate issues as necessary. • Assist in the development and improvement of incident response procedures and documentation. Vulnerability Management • Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and scans to identify security weaknesses. • Collaborate with IT teams to remediate identified vulnerabilities and ensure timely patch management. • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of emerging vulnerabilities and threats. Security Awareness and Training • Support the development and delivery of security awareness training programs for employees. • Assist in creating security awareness materials such as newsletters, posters, and emails to educate staff on best practices. • Conduct phishing simulations and analyze the results to identify areas for improvement. Compliance and Policy Enforcement • Assist in ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., OSFI, NIST, ISO27001 etc). • Help enforce organizational security policies and procedures. • Participate in internal and external security audits as needed. Security Projects and Research • Contribute to security-related projects and initiatives aimed at improving the overall security posture of the organization. • Conduct research on new security technologies, tools, and methodologies. • Assist in evaluating and recommending security solutions to address organizational needs. Develop positive working relationships with various teams involved in security and privacy matters • Job Requirements Key Qualifications: Educational Requirements • Currently enrolled in a degree program in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Relevant coursework in cybersecurity, network security, or information assurance is preferred. • Technical Skills • Familiarity with common information security concepts, practices, and tools. • Basic understanding of network protocols, operating systems, and security architecture. Experience with security monitoring tools, vulnerability scanners, and incident response procedures is a plus. • Soft Skills • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. Attention to detail and a proactive approach to security issues • Citizenship Requirement N/A APPLICATION INFORMATION Application Procedure Through Employer Website Special Application Instructions Please click the "I intend to apply to this position" button on SCOPE and also submit your application via the employer's website.
